custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Inventory Part" window opens.

Step 2:

  • A hover text appears beside the icon and reads, word for word: "Tracked parts keep a stock count, with Min and Max. Turn this off for items you don't count. Untracked parts are left out of the Inventory Value report."
  • All three sentences are there, the last one about the Inventory Value report included.

Step 3:

  • The window closes and no part is created.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part)

  • S4-R3: “The heading has an info icon. Hovering it shows "Tracked parts keep a stock count, with Min and Max. Turn this off for items you don't count. Untracked parts are left out of the Inventory Value report."”
